_comment: Treasure: maps, wrecks, buried chests. Many are chains: a first event queues a second that waits for you somewhere. See docs/events.md.

treasure_dig.title: Where the chart leads
treasure_dig.text: {port}. Beyond the town the coast matches the chart in your coat: the headland, the creek, the cross.

choices.result: You count the paces off the chart and put the spades in.
choices.fail_result: Two days of digging in the wrong place. You must have counted from the wrong palm.

choices.text: Pay a local who knows the place to show you
choices.result: An old fisherman knows the spot at once. By tonight the whole waterfront will know you dug there.

choices.text: Sell the chart to some local fool
choices.result: They pay eighty and run off with a spade.
The chart goes back in your coat. It will keep.

map_seller.title: A treasure map, cheap
map_seller.text: A one-eyed man in the market unrolls a stained chart: 'Spanish gold, Captain, on an island near {port}. Yours for {price} pieces.'

choices.result: You pocket the chart. Whether it's genuine, only a spade will tell.
Of the three charts he unrolls, two are new ink on old paper. The third was drawn by someone who sailed that coast. You pay for that one.
choices.fail_result: They all look genuine enough. You pay for the first.

choices.result: He tries the next captain along.

map_thief.title: The chart is gone
map_thief.text: Your sea chest was opened in the night and the treasure chart is missing. {sailor} was seen poring over a scrap of paper by lantern light.

choices.result: The chart is rolled up inside a spare shirt. {sailor} swears it was only borrowed.
choices.fail_result: Nothing in the bag, and the crew mutter about a captain who searches honest hands. The chart stays gone.

choices.result: On the fourth stroke {sailor} tells you where it's hidden.

choices.text: Promise {sailor} a share of whatever it leads to
choices.result: The chart comes back, with a promise you'll have to keep.
Let them have it. It was probably a forgery anyway.

map_buyer.title: An offer for the chart
map_buyer.text: Word has got round that you carry a treasure chart. An agent for some merchant house finds you in the tavern: 'Two hundred for it, Captain, and no questions about where it leads.'

choices.result: Gold in hand beats gold in the ground.
You talk of rival buyers until the agent goes to three hundred and fifty.
choices.fail_result: The agent smiles, finishes their wine and leaves. The offer goes with them.

choices.result: The agent shrugs. Others will ask.

old_hand_chart.title: An old hand's chart
old_hand_chart.text: {sailor}, who has sailed these waters longer than anyone aboard, comes to your cabin with a greasy scrap of chart. 'Buried it myself near {port}, back when I sailed with worse than you. I'm too old to dig alone. Take me there and I'll take a double share.'

choices.result: You shake on it. The chart goes in your coat.
{sailor} takes the money, and looks at you as if you'd robbed a grave.
{sailor} folds the chart away and doesn't raise it again.

silver_wreck.title: A wreck on the shoals
silver_wreck.text: In clear water over a reef, the outline of an old ship: ribs, ballast stones, and something glinting.

choices.result: Pieces of eight, fused into lumps by the sea. Still silver.
choices.fail_result: A diver comes up too fast, and doesn't come round.

choices.text: Mark the spot and move on
choices.result: You note the bearings in the log.

cursed_coins.title: Aztec gold
cursed_coins.text: {sailor} comes to you pale: the gold coins from the last prize carry strange heathen faces, and the men who handled them have been dreaming of drowning.

choices.result: The dreams stop. So does a share of your fortune.
Gold is gold.
choices.fail_result: Half the crew won't go below at night.

choices.result: A priest at the next port earns a fat fee.

buried_by_crew.title: Hidden shares
buried_by_crew.text: {sailor} confesses, drunk: some of the crew buried their own shares of plunder on a beach near {port}, rather than trust them to you.

choices.text: Go and dig it up yourself
choices.result: You'll be in {port} soon enough.

choices.text: Say nothing. A man's share is his own
choices.result: Word gets round that you heard and let it be.

hidden_shares_dig.title: The crew's cache
hidden_shares_dig.text: At {port} you slip ashore at night with a lantern and a spade.

choices.result: Three hundred in coin. By morning the whole ship knows.

choices.text: Leave it. Think better of it
choices.result: You walk back empty-handed.
